scripts.build: bun build index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && bun build test.ts --target=node --format=esm --external ./index.ts --outfile=dist/test.js && bun build test.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external ./index.ts --outfile=dist/test.cjs && bun build sqlite.ts --target=node --format=esm --external ./index.ts --outfile=dist/sqlite.js && bun build sqlite.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external ./index.ts --outfile=dist/sqlite.cjs && bunx tsc --ignoreConfig index.ts test.ts sqlite.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --allowImportingTsExtensions --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ES2022 --types node --skipLibCheck --outDir dist/types && bun scripts/fix-declaration-imports.ts
scripts.lint:package: bun run build && publint && bun scripts/run-attw.ts && knip
scripts.release:check: bun run test:all && bun run lint:package && bun run audit:package && bun run security:audit
scripts.test:all: bun run build && bun run test:types && bun test tests/unit tests/integration
